What this idea lets you do: only signal is allowed inside the garden; speech must grow on a separate mouth outside. Once tired, the habit was to open another ████ and stack upward: more tools, less contact. What this idea lets you do: freeze the plan, issue only one relation-word at the door—block, leak light, let pass, watch. The drawing shows only that kind of edge; other lines recede. One experiment card: site, today's verb, allowed edges, closed edges.

**Mute scoring, used to split looking and writing into two shifts of labor**
Watching markets, assignments, or papers, a sentence would appear and the judgment would be written smooth. What this idea lets you do: the slip keeps only three cells—pass / send back / not allowed to write tonight. Until they are filled, the keyboard may not produce sentences. If a reason must be written, open another period, and it cannot change scores already given.
